 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Tile the input with its 90, 180, and 270 degree rotations."""
    def rotate_cw(matrix):
        return [list(row) for row in zip(*matrix[::-1])]

    original = [list(row) for row in grid]
    clockwise = rotate_cw(original)
    half_turn = rotate_cw(clockwise)
    counterclockwise = rotate_cw(half_turn)
    return [a + b for a, b in zip(original, clockwise)] + [
        a + b for a, b in zip(counterclockwise, half_turn)
    ]
"
